about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) hiya akbar qanat akhbar li-mujtama3 al-furry fi Asia, wa maqarruha Singapore.

about.body-3: Fariq GFTV dawli wa muta3addid al-thaqafat wa al-lughat, yamtadd min al-wa6an 3abr al-qarrat al-kubra.
